en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town surrounded by fields and rolling hills. The settlement includes dense clusters of houses, a few factory chimneys, and larger institutional-looking buildings along the edge of town. Trees line some roads and the foreground consists mainly of cultivated fields. At the bottom center border, the caption 'Zschopau' is printed in a serif font.
